rep.angle: lead with a recent hiring push you noticed
rep.name: Dev

rep_lines.text: Hi Dana, Dev from HyperSale. I noticed Brightpath’s recent sales hiring push—can I take 30 seconds to explain why ramp consistency prompted my call?
HyperSale lets new reps practice realistic buyer calls before prospects, while managers see quote-backed progress weekly. How are you keeping ramp quality consistent across hires?
That makes sense—Gong is strong after the call; HyperSale adds practice before it. Where are new hires rehearsing before live prospects today?
I hear you—this should save manager time, not add work. How many live prospect calls does each hire need before they’re consistently ready?
We compare pilot reps’ time to consistency and first-call quality against your dozen-call baseline; every score cites the quote. How many hires this quarter?
Annual pricing is $90 per rep monthly; pilot cost depends on team size. How many of the 15 would you want included?
Thirteen reps cost $14,040 annually; all 15 cost $16,200. Could we scope a 30-day pilot Tuesday at 2 with you and enablement?
Perfect—I’ll send Tuesday at 2 with you and enablement to scope the 13-rep pilot. Thanks, Dana.

criteria.rationale: You consistently picked up the buyer’s exact concerns—Gong, manager workload, and the dozen-call baseline—and used them to shape your next question. Keep this structure, but slow down enough to make each reflection sound conversational rather than compressed.
